_comment: Curated layer for docs/data-dictionary.md, keyed by table.column. 'traces' is the ADR / issue the column serves and marks the row as reviewed; 'note' is free text. Regenerate with make data-dictionary.

tracks.bit_depth.note: Container bit depth (FLAC, WAV, AIFF, APE, WavPack, ALAC); NULL for lossy formats. Was NULL everywhere until #405; full rescan backfills.

tracks.key.note: Musical key from INITIALKEY. Fully wired but empty in a library tagged without a key detector; no smart-playlist field yet.

tracks.start_offset_ms.note: CUE virtual-track design retired; no writer since M038 deleted virtual rows. To be dropped.

tracks.source_file_url.note: Pointed a virtual ?cue=N row at its real file. Every row's file_url is now the real file. To be dropped.

tracks.musicbrainz_album_artist_id.note: Album-artist MBID per track (Picard MUSICBRAINZ_ALBUMARTISTID). The identify UI labels this 'Artist MBID'. Track-artist MBID has no column yet (#399).

tracks.musicbrainz_release_id.note: Populated per track; never rolled up to albums (#402).

tracks.musicbrainz_release_group_id.note: Populated per track; never rolled up to albums (#402).

tracks.track_total.note: From TRACKTOTAL / TOTALTRACKS, or the N of an n/N TRACKNUMBER (ID3v2 TRCK, MP4 trkn) since #404.

tracks.disc_total.note: Same sources as track_total, via DISCTOTAL / TOTALDISCS or n/N DISCNUMBER.

artists.sort_name.note: Never written: ARTISTSORT is read into TrackTags and dropped at ArtistRepository.findOrCreate(name:). Artist sort degrades to display name.

artists.musicbrainz_artist_id.note: Never written: bridge does not read MUSICBRAINZ_ARTISTID and findOrCreate takes a name only. Needed by Deep Dive.

artists.disambiguation.note: No writer, reader, or source; needs a MusicBrainz artist lookup.

albums.musicbrainz_release_id.note: Never written. LibraryStatsRepository+Hygiene reads it, so 'Albums Missing MusicBrainz ID' reports every album.

albums.musicbrainz_release_group_id.note: Never written; rollup rule needed because 17 albums have mixed release groups across tracks.

albums.release_type.note: Never written; bridge does not read RELEASETYPE.

albums.total_tracks.note: MAX(tracks.track_total) via AlbumRepository.recomputeTotals, called by TrackImporter and EditTransaction; M040 backfilled. NULL when no track carries a total. Drives AlbumDetailView's 'N songs'.

cover_art.width.note: Set by CoverArtCache.persist since 2026-04 only; save() ignores existing hashes so older rows stay NULL.

cover_art.byte_size.note: Only the MusicBrainz batch tool sets it.

cover_art.source.note: Vocabulary embedded|sidecar|musicbrainz|user; only 'musicbrainz' is ever written.

lyrics.offset_ms.note: Read on load, never written: the sync-offset slider is session-only.

scrobble_queue.payload_title.note: Subsonic-only snapshot; local plays join tracks/albums at submit time.

scrobble_queue.payload_album.note: Subsonic-only; never set because QueuePlayer.notifyHistoryStart hardcodes album nil (#408).

podcasts.itunes_collection_id.note: Dropped at the UI subscribe seam and wiped by upsertByFeedURL on refresh. No reader.

podcasts.subscribed.note: Always 1: unsubscribe hard-deletes the row, so the three subscribed == true filters are no-ops.

podcasts.sort_index.note: PodcastService.reorder exists; no UI calls it.

podcasts.persons_json.note: Show-level credits; written via GRDB record encoding, so it works.

podcast_episodes.artwork_path.note: cacheEpisodeArt has no callers; upsertOne would overwrite it with NULL on refresh.

podcast_episodes.persons_json.note: Was omitted from EpisodeRepository.upsertOne until #411; M039 forces a re-parse to backfill.

track_dsp_assignments.bass_boost_db.note: DDL only; repository handles eq_preset_id alone.

track_dsp_assignments.crossfeed_amount.note: DDL only; grep matches the global DSP state, not this column.

track_dsp_assignments.stereo_width.note: DDL only; grep matches the global DSP state, not this column.
